data.one_liner: Adds background playback and media controls to a just_audio player
data.what_it_does: It plugs into just_audio to enable background playback, media notifications, lock‑screen controls and remote button handling across Android, iOS, web and macOS. The package handles the platform‑specific setup and exposes a simple API for initializing the background service.
use_when: You have a single AudioPlayer instance and want background playback with standard media controls
You need quick integration without writing custom audio_service code
avoid_when: Your app requires multiple simultaneous audio players
You need fine‑grained control over notification buttons or custom media actions
strengths: Easy to add to existing just_audio projects
Handles notification and remote control plumbing automatically
weaknesses: Not suitable for complex audio service features
data.setup_notes: Android: add WAKE_LOCK, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, optionally FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK permissions; add AudioServiceActivity, AudioService, MediaButtonReceiver to AndroidManifest. iOS: add UIBackgroundModes audio to Info.plist. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: audio_service
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides full control over multiple players, custom notification actions, and advanced background behavior
